entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I ordered something, and I need to send it back. I was looking at the website and it's all so confusing. I'm not sure what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. I just need to pull up your account first. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller. The order number is... umm... VF77819. It's for a jersey.
Thank you, Sarah. I have your order right here. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's just the wrong size. I thought a medium would work but it's just way too tight across the shoulders. I tried it on once and knew right away. I think I need to exchange it, but the policy page had so many dates and rules... can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help clarify that for you. There's no need to worry. Let me just check the policy for this item. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I'd really appreciate it.

Alright Sarah, I have good news. I can see your jersey was delivered 29 days ago. Since that's a standard VeloFit apparel item, it falls under our 10-day return policy. You're unfortunately outside the timeframe to make an exchange for the correct size.
Oh, really? Ninety days? That's such a relief! I thought I might be too late. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I'm processing the exchange for you now and I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on your account. Just package the jersey that's too tight, apply the label, and drop it at any post office. We'll send out the new size as soon as the return is scanned.
That's perfect. That's so much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you, David!
Happy to help, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. You've been a great help.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
